address: 长宁区江苏路街道愚园路1107号8号楼, 上海市（距地铁11号线江苏路站8号口步行400米）
description_en: Dessert bakery run by Shanghai Bebeike Catering Co., Ltd (上海彼焙窠餐饮有限责任公司). WeChat mini-program: bebaked (in-store pickup or delivery); Xiaohongshu: bebaked. This location is in a lane house on Yuyuan Road, a 400m walk from Exit 8 of Jiangsu Road station on metro Line 11. Hours 8:00-22:00. Menu: thousand-layer matcha roll, black sesame mochi Basque cheesecake, oozing matcha cocoa tart, black sesame soy milk roll, caramel mille-feuille tart. Prices run 10-45rmb. bebaked has 2 locations in Shanghai (Yuyuan Lane House, Zhenru Universal City).
description_zh: 以甜品烘焙为主的品牌，由上海彼焙窠餐饮有限责任公司运营。微信小程序：bebaked（可以门店自提或外送到家）；小红书：bebaked。本店位于愚园路洋房，距地铁11号线江苏路站8号口步行400米，营业时间8:00-22:00。菜单：千目抹茶卷、黑芝麻麻薯巴斯克、流心抹茶可可挞、黑芝麻豆乳卷、焦糖千层挞，价格在10-45rmb之间。bebaked在上海共有2家门店（愚园洋房店、真如环宇城店）。
